name: Boon of Erupting Spellpower

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Once until you roll Initiative or rest, a damaging spell you cast with a slot turns its 1s and 2s into 3s and knocks the creatures it damages Prone.

benefits.name: Erupting Spellpower
benefits.summary: A damaging spell cast with a slot: 1s and 2s on its damage dice count as 3s, and each creature it damages falls Prone. Back when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.
benefits.text: When you cast a spell with a spell slot and it deals damage, each 1 or 2 on its damage dice counts as a 3, and each creature it damages falls Prone. Once used, it comes back when you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest. It's used on the first such spell unless you turn it Off in the class tab.
